# Code of conduct

Breader is a quiet place to read, and this is a quiet place to build it. Be kind.

## What we ask

- Be welcoming to everyone, whatever their age, body, ability, background, identity, experience, looks, nationality, religion or beliefs.
- Disagree about ideas, never about people.
- Assume good intent, and say sorry when you get it wrong.
- Help newcomers; everyone was one once.

## What's not okay

- Insults, slurs, put-downs, or attacks on anyone.
- Harassment, in public or in private, including unwanted attention or contact.
- Sexual language or images.
- Sharing anyone's private details, such as their address, email or library key, without their clear permission.
- Anything else a reasonable person would see as out of place.

## Where it applies

Everywhere Breader is discussed: issues, pull requests, Discussions, and anywhere you speak for the project.

## Reporting

Email [magicalfizz@gmail.com](mailto:magicalfizz@gmail.com) with what happened, where, and links if you have them. Every report is read and kept private.

## What happens

The maintainer decides what to do, from a private word, to a public warning, to a temporary or lasting ban, depending on how serious it is and whether it happened before.

## Credit

Adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.
